createhandcogwheel.ponder.hand_cogwheel_: The Hand Cogwheel combines a Hand Crank with a small Cogwheel.
Hold Right-Click to turn the handle and generate temporary rotational force.
Sneak while using it to reverse the generated rotation.
Turning it consumes hunger according to Create's crankHungerMultiplier setting.
The Extendo Grip retains Create's normal exemption from crank hunger consumption.
Its teeth mesh with adjacent small Cogwheels on the same axis.
Each meshed Cogwheel rotates in the opposite direction and relays the generated force.
Cogwheels only mesh when their rotation axes and relative positions are compatible.
Hold a Hand Cogwheel and look near a Cogwheel's rim to preview a valid placement.
The back of the Hand Cogwheel exposes a direct shaft connection.
Shafts on the same axis receive the generated speed without a gear ratio change.
Looking at a Shaft end while holding the item shows a placement preview on that axis.
Hold Sneak while placing to bypass the guide and use normal block placement.
The block can be oriented along X, Y, or Z and can also be waterlogged.
